1.

What comfort it gives each soul, How sweet, that the heart knows: For those who believe all is well In time and eternity.

2.

In all things they stand secure, Whatever may yet meet them, For the Saviour shall go with them, His eye follows them.

3.

All is well, if here they must Yet tarry for a time, And if through death they pass To heaven’s rest and peace.

4.

All is well in the narrow vale As on the mountain’s height, All is well in joy and song, In all distress they have hope.

5.

All is well, when song ascends And the path appears bright, So also all is well in severe trial, In sorrow and temptations.

6.

Well, when with sounds of joy To the heights they go, And all is well, so God accounts, When in the fiery trial they stand.

7.

And last, how wondrous, When Jesus’ word reaches them And they hear the trumpet clearly, They shall meet Him!
